```{r}
critWeight <- tibble(
  criterion = c("`Cost ($/MWh)`", "CO2_Intensity_kg_per_MWh", "`efficiency%`", "CtoE_Ratio"),
  direction = c("cost","cost","benefit","benefit"),
  weight = as.integer(c(35,35,15,15))
)

myPie <- critWeight %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(criterion, "\n", weight, "%"))

ggplot(myPie, aes(x="", y=weight, fill=criterion))+geom_col(width=1)+coord_polar(theta="y")+geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 10)+theme_void()+theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
energy <- py$energy_df
glimpse(energy)
perfVal <-energy %>%
  select(fueltypeid, `Cost ($/MWh)`, `efficiency%`, CO2_Intensity_kg_per_MWh, CtoE_Ratio) %>%
  pivot_longer(-fueltypeid, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    value = ifelse(metric == "CtoE_Ratio", value*100, value),
    value = ifelse(is.infinite(value),NA,value)
  ) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(scaled = (value - min(value, na.rm = TRUE))/(max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(fueltypeid, metric) %>%
  summarise(mean_scaled = mean(scaled, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
glimpse(perfVal)
ggplot(perfVal, aes(x=fueltypeid, y=mean_scaled, fill = metric))+geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7)
perfVal %>% filter(metric == "CtoE_Ratio")
nucWat <- energy %>%
  filter(fueltypeid == "NUC", is.finite(CtoE_Ratio))
nucWat$CtoE_Ratio
```

```{r}
enerlong <- energy %>%
  select(fueltypeid, `Cost ($/MWh)`, `efficiency%`, CO2_Intensity_kg_per_MWh, CtoE_Ratio) %>%
  pivot_longer(-fueltypeid, names_to = "criterion", values_to = "value") %>%
  left_join(critWeight, by = "criterion")
# FIX JOIN TO AGGREGATE VALUES BEFORE JOINING

minmax <- enerlong %>%
  group_by(criterion, direction) %>%
  mutate(
    rng = max(value, na.rm = TRUE) - min(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    norm = case_when(
      is.na(value) ~ NA_real_,
      rng == 0 ~ 1, 
      direction == "benefit" ~ (value - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) / rng,
      direction == "cost"   ~ (value - min(value, na.rm = TRUE)) / rng,
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

wsm <- minmax %>%
  mutate(weighted = norm * weight) %>%
  group_by(fueltypeid) %>%
  summarise(WSM_score = sum(weighted), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(WSM_score))
wsm


```
